# Ballard & Fremont Dispatch

> The Ballard & Fremont Dispatch is a free weekly email newsletter about Seattle, WA, sent Thursdays at 6 AM Pacific and published by Neighborhood Press LLC. It covers city council decisions, land-use and permit notices, road and transit changes, school district news, openings and closings, with one section per neighborhood. Every item links its public source. It is researched and written with AI tools, and an editor reads every issue before it goes out.

## Key pages
- [This week in Ballard & Fremont](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/this-week/): the dated items for the current week, updated every Thursday
- [Ballard & Fremont news](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/news/): every story, newest first
- [Reader asked](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/asked/): readers' questions answered from the public record
- [Standards](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/standards/): publisher, sources, sponsors, corrections
- [Subscribe](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/): free, one email a week

## Neighborhoods
- [Ballard](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/ballard/): Ballard Avenue NW and NW Market Street, the Ballard Locks and their fish ladder, Ballard Commons Park and the Sunday farmers market on Ballard Avenue.
- [Sunset Hill](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/sunset-hill/): The bluff over Shilshole Bay, with the Sunset Hill Park viewpoint on 34th Avenue NW, Golden Gardens Park and Shilshole Bay Marina along Seaview Avenue NW.
- [Loyal Heights](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/loyal-heights/): The streets between NW 65th and NW 85th Streets west of 15th Avenue NW, with Loyal Heights Playfield and views west over the Sound to the Olympics.
- [Crown Hill](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/crown-hill/): The NW 85th Street and 15th Avenue NW crossing, the Holman Road NW corridor, Crown Hill Park and the RapidRide D Line stops.
- [West Woodland](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/west-woodland/): The streets between 15th Avenue NW and the foot of Phinney Ridge, from the Leary Way NW shops up to NW 65th Street, crossed by NW Market Street.
- [Phinney Ridge](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/phinney-ridge/): The ridge along Phinney Avenue North, with Woodland Park Zoo, the Woodland Park Rose Garden and the Phinney Avenue shops.
- [Greenwood](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/greenwood/): The Greenwood Avenue North business district around North 85th Street, Greenwood Park and the Greenwood library branch.
- [Green Lake](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/green-lake/): The 2.8-mile path around the lake, the Bathhouse Theatre on the west shore, the community center and pool, and the Aurora Avenue North edge.
- [Fremont](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/fremont/): The Ship Canal waterfront, the Fremont Bridge, the Troll under the Aurora Bridge, the Burke-Gilman Trail and the Sunday market on North 34th Street.
- [Wallingford](https://www.ballardfremontdispatch.com/wallingford/): The North 45th Street shops, Wallingford Playfield, and Gas Works Park on Lake Union with the Burke-Gilman Trail along the shore.
